red_tests.requirement: grid and PSTF source actions must carry the same source_bundle_sha256
serialization must retain positive eta and kappa separately and derive signed chi
a physical eta>kappa pair with chi<0 must not be rejected as negative opacity
exact polynomial-rate projection must reject L_work < L_out + L_chi
for an exactly band-limited manufactured state, grid projection and native PSTF source action agree at the declared quadrature precision
same-cutoff mutation must expose the exact missed rank-three/rank-four source terms
anisotropic exponential jump must refuse a finite-exact-tail claim
isotropic jump is rank preserving and provides the control limit
TEFF diagnostics are read-only and cannot replace or mutate the BASS state
a 26-direction readout without parent state, source and background hashes is rejected
hydrogen propagation direction and outward-sky direction require an explicit sign adapter
full spectral grid state and radially integrated angular-density state cannot be declared byte-or-semantic equivalents
